issues.description: The UML in the problem statement specifies messageOnFeed() as public (shown with '+'), whereas the reference implementation declares it as protected in src/de/tum/cit/ase/Animal.java. This visibility mismatch between the specification and solution can confuse students about the intended access level (UML/description implying public API vs. solution using protected).
issues.suggestedFix: Make the abstract method visibility consistent with the UML/specification. Either change Animal.messageOnFeed() in src/de/tum/cit/ase/Animal.java to public abstract String messageOnFeed(), or update the problem statement/UML to indicate a protected abstract method so both artifacts match.
